谷歌手里有搜索、安卓、YouTube、Gmail、文档，还有自己设计的 AI 芯: Google has Search, Android, YouTube, Gmail and Docs, plus AI chips of its own design. Gemini's play is to put the model inside products billions of people already use, rather than just ship a separate chat app. Remember, the Transformer came out of Google in the first place.
要一次读完很长的材料（整本书、几小时的视频、一大堆文件），可以先试 Gemini: To read very long material in one go (a whole book, hours of video, a pile of files), try a strong long-context model like Gemini first. If you already live in Gmail and Google Docs, using it right there is smoother.
ChatGPT 出来时谷歌被打了个措手不及，早期的演示和图像生成都出过差错。AI: ChatGPT caught Google off guard, and its early demos and image generation both had mistakes. Now that AI answers sit inside Search, how that affects website traffic and creators' income is a new controversy. For the latest models, go by the official page.

2024 年 9 月 12 日，OpenAI 发布 o1 预览版。和以前的模型不: On 12 September 2024, OpenAI released o1-preview. Unlike earlier models, it first writes a long internal “thinking” passage before answering, reasoning step by step. OpenAI trained it with reinforcement learning to use that thinking well. On maths competition problems, coding and science questions, it scored far above the earlier GPT-4o.
方向变了：以前主要靠“训练时做得更大”，现在还可以靠“回答时多想一会儿”，用更多: The direction changed: before, progress came mainly from “bigger at training time”; now it can also come from “thinking longer at answer time”, trading more compute for better answers. Almost every lab then launched its own “thinking” mode.
难的分析、算账、写代码、多步骤的规划，值得打开“思考”模式；简单的改写、翻译、起: Hard analysis, calculations, code and multi-step planning are worth switching on “thinking” mode; simple rewrites, translations and naming are fine in fast mode, which is quicker and cheaper.
想得越久，越慢也越贵。模型展示出来的“思考过程”，不一定如实反映它真正是怎么算出: The longer it thinks, the slower and more expensive it gets. Researchers are still debating whether the “thinking” a model shows faithfully reflects how it actually reached its answer.

2025 年 1 月 20 日，杭州的深度求索发布推理模型 DeepSeek-R: On 20 January 2025, Hangzhou-based DeepSeek released the reasoning model DeepSeek-R1, with open weights that allow commercial use. Its scores on maths, coding and reasoning tests were close to OpenAI's o1, at a much lower API price. The paper published the main training method: heavy use of reinforcement learning so the model learns step-by-step reasoning on its own.
它让很多人重新估算“做一个顶尖模型到底要花多少钱”。发布一周后，美国芯片股大跌，: It made many people recalculate how much a frontier model really costs. A week after release, US chip stocks plunged, and about US$590 billion was wiped off Nvidia's value in a single day. It also showed that reasoning ability can be released openly for anyone in the world to download and study.
做中文内容、预算紧、想自己部署的团队，可以把它列进候选。用官方应用和接口时，要留: Teams working on Chinese content, on a tight budget, or wanting to self-host can put it on the shortlist. When using the official app and API, note where the data is stored and which country's laws apply.
560 万美元只是最后一次训练的估算，不包括前期研究和其他开销。外界对它的训练数: The US$5.6 million is only an estimate for the final training run, excluding earlier research and other costs. There is much speculation about its training data sources and true compute scale, and government agencies in several countries have restricted its use on official devices.

2025 年，AI 从“回答问题”走向“替你把事做完”。2 月，Anthropi: In 2025, AI moved from “answering questions” to “getting things done for you”. In February, Anthropic released a preview of Claude Code: it reads code, edits files and runs commands directly in the computer's terminal, with a general release in May. The same year, OpenAI launched the Codex coding agent, and Google launched the Antigravity development platform alongside Gemini 3.
一个能自己拆任务、调用工具、检查结果再修改的 AI，用法就从“问答”变成了“派活: With an AI that can break down tasks, call tools, check results and revise on its own, the way you use it shifts from “Q&A” to “handing out work”. The human's role becomes: set the goal, provide the material, sign off the result.
花屿这个网站就是这样做出来的：网页和文字由 Claude Code 写，插画由: This site, Onbloom Island, was made exactly this way: the pages and text were written by Claude Code and the illustrations drawn by Codex, each time working from a clearly written ticket, with a person signing off the result. Our experience: spelling out what counts as done matters more than teaching it how to do the job.
智能体会犯错，而且错误可能直接落到真实的文件和账户上，所以权限要收紧，关键操作要: Agents make mistakes, and those mistakes can land directly on real files and accounts, so keep permissions tight and have a person confirm key actions. How much work they can replace, and how much they will affect jobs, has no reliable answer yet.

2025 年，Meta 重组 AI 团队，成立超级智能实验室，由 Scale A: In 2025, Meta reorganised its AI teams and set up Meta Superintelligence Labs, led by Scale AI founder Alexandr Wang. On 8 April 2026, the lab released its first model, Muse Spark.
官方说它“小而快”，能推理科学、数学、健康方面的复杂问题，能看懂图片和图表；有“: Meta describes it as “small and fast”, able to reason through complex questions in science, maths and health, and to understand images and charts. It has “Instant” and “Thinking” modes, and can dispatch several sub-agents at once to work on the same problem in parallel.
和 Llama 不同，Muse Spark 不能下载，开发者只能通过向部分合作方: Unlike Llama, Muse Spark can't be downloaded; developers can only use it through a private preview API open to selected partners. Meta says it “hopes to open-source future versions”. That the company once most eager to push open weights has turned closed shows frontier competition has become so expensive that even Meta has to redo the sums.
Meta 的优势是分发：几十亿人每天打开的聊天和社交应用。对做营销和内容的人来说: Meta's advantage is distribution: chat and social apps billions of people open every day. For people in marketing and content, AI growing right into Instagram and WhatsApp means users will ask AI directly in chat and search boxes. How your content gets found and cited by AI will matter more and more.
